svg.title: Kodak Portra 800 — spektrafilm profile graph
svg.desc: Three-panel graph showing the source profile's spectral log sensitivity sampled every 5 nanometres from 380 to 780 nm, the characteristic density curves reconstructed from the supplied normal-CDF model parameters, and the processed-medium spectral-density curves from the profile's base_density and midscale_neutral_density fields.
svg.metadata: spektrafilm by Andrea Volpato https://github.com/andreavolpato/spektrafilm Licensed CC BY-SA 4.0 Modified 2026-09-06: source profile values plotted as SVG; characteristic curves evaluated from the profile's fitted normal-CDF model; processed-medium spectral-density curves added from base_density and midscale_neutral_density. No source measurements or model parameters altered.
svg.text: Color negative film · reference illuminant D55 · Status M densitometry · processed-medium spectral density included
spectral-density curves from base_density and midscale_neutral_density
Min = processed unexposed medium · Midscale neutral = processed neutral midscale density
